ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportRetentionPo.description:
ImportRetentionPolicy is the Stage 07 required retention selection. Every
 class must be chosen before import; missing retention fails closed at the
 boundary and never defaults raw media silently.

derivativeRetention.description: derivative_retention is the selected transcript/notes retention policy.

rawMediaRetention.description: raw_media_retention is the selected raw-media retention policy.

screenshotRetention.description: screenshot_retention is the selected screenshot retention policy.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportRetentionPo.title: Import Retention Policy

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportTranscriptS.description: ImportTranscriptSuccess returns the admitted meeting identity and readiness.

meetingSessionId.description: meeting_session_id is the opaque admitted meeting identity.

retention.description: retention echoes the selected retention policy.

segmentCount.description: segment_count is the admitted segment count.

sourceScope.description: source_scope echoes the explicit authorized import scope.

state.description: state is READY or PARTIAL for a successful import.
state.title: Meeting Lifecycle State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportTranscriptS.title: Import Transcript Success
